intent: Create a wide architecture-exhibition hero image showing a quiet material research pavilion, with spatial clarity and a premium but non-commercial sense of discovery.

creative_routing.audience_effect: invite slow visual exploration and make construction logic understandable
creative_routing.delivery_context: wide exhibition announcement and website hero
creative_routing.design_priority: spatial circulation, material junctions, human scale, and clean copy-safe space
creative_routing.cultural_context: contemporary material research with no invented historical symbolism
creative_routing.mix_rule: graphic modernism controls grid and hierarchy; minimal object study controls only material isolation and quiet negative space
creative_routing.adaptation_rule: preserve graphite/copper hierarchy while architecture, human scale, daylight, and circulation remain authoritative

scene.summary: A low pavilion of rammed earth, darkened timber, and translucent recycled glass forms a walkable sequence of thresholds.
scene.setting: large neutral gallery with one pavilion, a shallow reflecting strip, and two distant visitors

subjects.description: one inhabitable material-research pavilion with three offset walls and a narrow luminous threshold
subjects.action: guides two distant visitors through a compressed entrance into an open central bay
subjects.pose: low horizontal mass with one vertical light joint
subjects.scale: visitors establish full human scale without becoming portrait subjects
relationships: reflecting strip follows the circulation edge
visitors remain separated by one threshold

composition.framing: pavilion spans the lower two thirds; circulation enters from left foreground; upper-right wall remains copy-safe
depth_layers: dark floor edge and reflecting strip

lighting.summary: large overhead daylight washes the gallery while one narrow warm threshold reveals material depth
lighting.key: broad cool daylight from clerestory panels
lighting.direction: top left with a narrow warm vertical counterpoint
lighting.contrast: controlled material separation without theatrical black crush
lighting.color_temperature: cool-neutral gallery daylight and one warm threshold
practicals: concealed warm source inside the narrow threshold

materials.description: rammed earth, charred timber, translucent recycled glass, and shallow water
materials.microstructure: layered earth compaction, open charred grain, seeded recycled-glass inclusions
materials.roughness: high on earth and timber, variable on glass, low only on shallow water
materials.specular_response: broad mineral highlights, narrow wet edge, rough translucent glass reflection
materials.transmission: diffuse through recycled glass with visible thickness and inclusions
materials.wear_patina: controlled construction marks and slight water mineral deposits
materials.contact_deformation: heavy earth walls meet floor with credible weight, shadow gap, and no floating edges

style.medium: photoreal architectural visualization with editorial restraint

render_pipeline.lighting_transport: dynamic real-time diffuse interreflection and indirect specular with a declared fidelity/performance balance
render_pipeline.global_illumination: Lumen-like sky-shadowed interior GI with soft infinite-bounce color bleed kept subtle
render_pipeline.ray_tracing: software/hardware-ray-tracing appearance for roughness-aware reflections and large-space visibility
render_pipeline.reflection_model: roughness-correct earth, timber, glass, and water reflections; screen-space loss must not erase offscreen contribution
render_pipeline.shadow_model: virtual-shadow-map-like contact precision plus soft clerestory penumbra
render_pipeline.ambient_occlusion: local at wall-floor junctions and threshold contacts only
render_pipeline.volumetrics: clear gallery air with no decorative fog
render_pipeline.material_workflow: PBR metallic-roughness materials with scale-accurate textures and high-precision normals
render_pipeline.subsurface_scattering: none for the pavilion; visitors retain subtle skin response
render_pipeline.transmission_refraction: high-quality front-layer glass transmission with roughness and interior inclusions
render_pipeline.displacement_normal: earth layer relief and timber grain remain scale-correct without noisy tessellation
render_pipeline.texture_scale: human-scale material texture remains coherent from foreground to pavilion
render_pipeline.sampling_denoise: stable temporal appearance with no reflection shimmer or smeared glass detail
render_pipeline.performance_fidelity_tradeoff: cinematic still prioritizes Lumen quality and reflection stability over gameplay frame rate

quality_controls: clean gradients and restrained reflections preserve dry mineral surfaces
